name: aws_cloudwatch_metric_stream_stopped
title: CloudWatch metric stream stopped
description: No rows reached the cloudwatch_metrics stream in the last 30 minutes. Firehose delivery has probably failed (for example a rotated passcode or a wrong endpoint), and every other CloudWatch alert has gone quiet. The query returns one row while data arrives; the alert fires when it returns none.

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) AS datapoints FROM "cloudwatch_metrics" HAVING count(*) > 0

row_template: No CloudWatch datapoints in the last 30 minutes
